description: SQLite: a VALUES list as a set operation's arm, a common table expression and a recursive anchor; row values compared, listed and assigned element by element; a division or remainder by a column, or by a remainder below one, may be NULL while one by 2 may not; PRAGMA statements return the columns SQLite gives them, and a setter that returns nothing has none; a select-list alias is an operand in WHERE; a double-quoted name that names no column is the string SQLite reads it as, with a Q063 warning each; JSONB columns read as JSON documents and STRING as text; the JSON functions take a blob document.
